fact: UNESCO's project 3210652071 (USD 166,800, 66% progress, 2024-2025) on digital skills and media and information literacy for populations is on going, with an allocation to this country (Cameroun 35%).
ANTIC launched the sixth edition of the Cameroon Digital Skills Campaign in Douala, a three-day event with over 100 students.

MINPOSTEL reports the minister launched on 11 June 2025 a Digital Citizenship Festival, organised by CODAM Technologies under ministry patronage within the national cybersecurity campaign, aiming to train 50,000 young people through regional and national events with hands-on workshops; no number trained is stated.
